I am 62 years old. I have farmed for 50 years since I was 12. My father taught me everything. I finished middle school, so I can read fertilizer bags and calculate money, but the field is my real teacher. I have 25.1 mu in Quzhou County. My wife and I manage it. We are only two people, so for 25 mu I must hire machines. I cannot do this by hand anymore.

I plant wheat in October and maize in June. I have done this wheat-maize rotation for decades. Last year my wheat gave me about 500 kg per mu, and my maize gave me about 600 kg per mu. This year I will do almost the same thing. Change is risky. I only adjust a little based on what I saw last year and what my neighbors do.

For wheat, I buy improved seeds from the seed shop. I use 30 jin per mu, which is 15 kg. I rotary till the land before sowing. The tractor driver charges 50 yuan per mu. For fertilizer, I spread one bag — 50 kg — of 18-18-5 compound fertilizer per mu before sowing. That gives 9 kg nitrogen, 9 kg phosphorus, and 2.5 kg potassium per mu. Then at jointing time in March, I spread another half bag of urea, about 25 kg per mu. Urea is 46% nitrogen, so that is 11.5 kg nitrogen. Total nitrogen for wheat is about 20.5 kg per mu. My neighbor Lao Wang uses this much and his wheat is always tall. I would rather spend a little more on fertilizer than have thin wheat. I irrigate four times: winter irrigation once after sowing, then at green-up, jointing, and grain filling. I pump from my well. Each irrigation costs about 12 yuan per mu for electricity. For chemicals, I spray herbicide once after sowing, and fungicide once at heading stage. That is two pesticide sprays.

For maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in early June. I use hybrid seeds — Nongda 372 or something similar from the dealer. One small package is about 1.2 kg per mu. I do no-tillage. There is no time to till between wheat harvest and maize sowing. If I till, I miss the good season. I put 40 kg per mu of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer in the row at sowing. That is 6 kg nitrogen, 6 kg phosphorus, 6 kg potassium per mu. Then at big trumpet stage in July, I spread 25 kg urea per mu, which is 11.5 kg nitrogen. Total nitrogen is 17.5 kg per mu. I irrigate twice: once at sowing if the soil is dry, and once at big trumpet when the ears are forming. For pests, I spray herbicide once, and insecticide once for corn borer. That is two pesticide applications.

I expect 550 kg per mu from wheat and 600 kg per mu from maize this year. If weather is good, maybe more. If it is dry, maybe less. But I know this system. It has fed my family for 50 years.
